recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
sed -r '/create\("release"\) \{/,/   \}/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
./gradlew assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/cclauncher-v6.1.2-arm64-v8a.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
